name: desire for safety
description: A sense that you are in existential or social danger.

variations.name: danger
variations.description: Your physical safety is threatened when your body is in danger. If someone is perceived as causing this threat, it can come with anger.

variations.name: will to live
variations.description: If your life is threatened, simple safety escalates to a will to survive.

variations.name: social threat
variations.description: Your social safety is threatened when your status and reputation are perceived as being attacked. This may come with anger or other negative social experiences like shame.

commentaries.quote: 'Safety' could be thought of as 'existential comfort' that is often prioritized over physical comfort. Because we're aware of how much we depend on others, we often link 'social comfort' and 'existential comfort'.

conditions: Social standing is perceived as being threatened.
The body is perceived as being threatened.
